text: See bd-01KZXJ882H70KWBCHQ4HAZZN50. measurement-kernel.R:236-238 sizes buffers by ALLOCATING them (object.size(matrix(0, rows, columns))), called four times at :242-245. At q=200 and feature_block=20000 that is ~128 MB allocated by the preflight itself before it reports whether the plan fits. Relevant to this epic because the 4 GiB peak-incremental-RSS gate would be measuring a preflight that inflates the very number it gates on. Exact arithmetic replacement verified: 8*rows*columns + 216.
